title: platform-standup-2026-03-04
content:
Date: 2026-03-04
Attendees: Ava Martinez (owner), Ravi Patel, Grace Huang, Ethan Cole, Maya Singh, On-call: Ethan
Agenda: quick sync on control plane rollout, routing policy update, auth token rotation, quota enforcement changes, and outstanding blockers.

1) Control plane
- Progress: Canary rollout of control-plane v2.3.1 continues in us-west-2 (10% traffic). Telemetry shows normal CPU and latency; minor increase in control-plane API error 500s on token refresh path.
- Action: Ravi to open a follow-up PR to add stricter backoff on token-refresh retries (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/528).
- Blocker: PLAT-412 (control-plane: token refresh 500s under burst) - investigating correlation with auth service timeouts.
- Next: Ramp to 25% Friday if no regression for 24h.

2) Routing
- Progress: Smart routing updates for model variant fallbacks merged to staging. Routing policy now has per-route latency target overrides.
- Notes: Grace validated routing weight redistribution script; found edge-case when weights sum to 0 leading to division by zero (fixed in ROUTE script commit).
- Action: Grace to add extra unit tests and push to canary.

3) Auth
- Progress: Rolling token rotation scheduled for 2026-03-06 for internal service accounts. Draft runbook prepared.
- Concern: Some older Dedicated customers still using legacy auth flow; plan is to keep legacy tokens valid for 30 days after rotation.
- Action: Maya to coordinate comms with customer success and update runbook in Confluence (linked: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PLAT/Auth+Rotation).
- Blocker: Need final approval from Security for HSM key usage (ticket AUTH-128).

4) Quotas
- Progress: New quota enforcement layer (quota v1) is live on staging. It supports per-customer token budgets and burst windows.
- Observed: During load tests, quota enforcement added ~4ms median latency—acceptable. However, some customers saw unexpected rate-limit 429s due to sliding-window misconfiguration.
- Action: Ethan to adjust sliding-window parameters and re-run load tests.
- Follow-up: Add a per-customer quota-expose endpoint for debug (PLAT-433 planned).

5) Incidents / Oncall
- Ethan handled a minor degradation in us-east-1 where quota service OOMed; root cause was a memory leak in the in-memory cache. Patch merged (PR 531) and deployed to canary.
- Postmortem draft: PLAT-431 (owner: Ethan) — aims to be complete by 2026-03-07.

6) Misc / Notes
- Cost optimization: early findings from Optimize team show potential savings by increasing batching for short-completion models; platform to expose batching knobs per-model.
- Docs: Console team requested an API field for quota-explain to show recent quota usage samples.

Action items (owners):
- Ravi: Finish token-refresh backoff PR, link to PLAT-412. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Grace: Add unit tests for routing weight-edge case and push canary. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Maya: Finalize auth rotation runbook and comms. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Ethan: Adjust quota sliding-window params and re-run load tests. Due: 2026-03-06.
- Ava: Coordinate canary ramp decision and publish canary health dashboard snapshot.

Open questions:
- Do we require a hotfix for legacy Dedicated customers before token rotation? (Action: Ava to review customer list)
- Should quota-explain be rate-limited differently for internal vs customer calls?

References: Jira: PLAT-412, PLAT-431, PLAT-433, AUTH-128. Slack thread: #platform-control-plane (see linked_artifacts). GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform

Next meeting: Daily standup 2026-03-05 10:00 PT. Weekly sync Friday 2026-03-06 11:00 PT.

Notes-to-self: document the token-refresh backoff hypothesis and include metric charts in the follow-up note. Some lines below are scratch: need to confirm whether KV cache invalidation happens on token rotate (TODO).
